headline: Turn the review-passes-with-unfixed-minors mechanism into deterministic code: a bundled check script (docs-priority derivation, gating-AC gap, spec/content boundary overlap, structural breaches) wired into decompose Step 8c, review Step 2.0, and revise Step 4, plus the missing decomposer rules for the three defect classes.

clusters.name: spec-content boundary overlap
clusters.detail: The format-defining epic (E001) authored a real content instance ('reference example of a correctly packaged tutorial') duplicating the sibling content epic's (E003) authoring surface. The internal re-review flagged it as minor after the pipeline had already reached BATCH_DONE (review passed 14/14), so no agent fixed it; the external scorer docked the point ('Epic Boundaries — solid with one minor overlap', 4/5). Root cause: decomposer lacks a spec-vs-content boundary rule; the first review missed the overlap stochastically.

clusters.name: docs-priority derivation skipped
clusters.detail: Rule exists (decompose Step 4, review Criterion 1) but the decomposer copied HLR-4's P2 label for the docs-authoring epic instead of deriving Major->P1 from the strategy's Jira priority. Behavioral miss: prose rule was skipped; nothing enforces it deterministically.

clusters.name: gating-AC gap
clusters.detail: E002's scope named a rollout gate ('feature flag / dashboard config gating') with no acceptance criterion verifying the gated behavior. Decompose Step 7 had no gating-coverage rule; review Criterion 6 did not name the pattern.

clusters.name: structural contract breaches (latent)
clusters.detail: Unresolvable dependencies, branch files missing branch/gated_by, main-plan epics depending on branch epics, epic_count mismatch, missing ai-signals rationale files, sibling draft-ID references in epic bodies — all checked only by hand in the review rubric; no deterministic self-check existed. No current val failures from this class (defensive depth for the same enforcement chain).

edits.title: New bundled script check_decomposition.py (mechanical checks + actionable findings + --self-check)
edits.verified: Ran on all 8 tasks' exact artifacts reconstructed from trajectories: flags exactly [docs-priority E004, gating-ac E002, spec-content E001] on case-019 (exit 1); exit 0 with zero findings on all 7 passing tasks. --self-check: 5 fixtures, all expected finding sets, ALL PASS. py_compile clean.

edits.title: decompose-agent Step 5: spec-vs-content boundary rule (missing rule + worked example)
edits.verified: Trigger condition (spec epic + authored-content sibling) verified absent from all 7 passing tasks' artifacts via the same predicate in the script scan; rule states both fix shapes matching the review's suggested fix.

edits.title: decompose-agent Step 7: gating-coverage rule for ACs
edits.verified: Gate-in-scope-without-AC condition verified unique to 019-E002 among all 8 tasks' artifacts.

edits.title: decompose-agent Step 8c: run check script to exit 0 before decompose_complete=true
edits.verified: Script exits 0 on all 7 passing tasks' post-decompose artifacts (revision deltas of 014/017/018/020 verified not to intersect check classes); path glob covers both observed runtime layouts.

edits.title: review-agent Step 2.0: mechanical pre-check folding script findings into the issues list
edits.verified: Same script, same inputs as E4 — exit 0 on passing tasks (no new issues, no threshold changes); findings-to-criterion/severity mapping matches the existing rubric's classes.

edits.title: review-agent Criterion 3: named spec-vs-content overlap pattern
edits.verified: Pattern absent from all 7 passing tasks' artifacts (verified by predicate scan); wording mirrors the 019 re-review's own finding.

edits.title: review-agent Criterion 6: named gating-coverage pattern
edits.verified: Pattern absent from all 7 passing tasks' artifacts.

edits.title: revise-agent Step 2: enumerated must-fix defect classes for minors + preserved judgment latitude for observations
edits.verified: Per-task trace check: 013 (no issues), 015/016 (observation minors left as now), 017 (signal fix keeps latitude), 018/020 (majors already fixed) — no passing task's revise behavior flips.

edits.title: revise-agent Epic Boundary recipe: spec-vs-content overlap (stub or subsume, never merge)
edits.verified: Fires only on the overlap class (absent from passing tasks); prevents the wrong merge-style fix.

edits.title: revise-agent Step 4: re-run check script to exit 0 after corrections
edits.verified: Script exits 0 on all 7 passing tasks' post-revision (= final) artifacts, verified directly.

skipped.title: gate_failure_impact / gated_by completeness check in the script
skipped.reason: Mechanically implementable but fires on passing case-020's post-decompose state (its first review flagged exactly this class); would change a passing task's trajectory without verification that the decomposer-time fix lands identically to the revise-time fix.

skipped.title: Review recommends revise whenever minors remain
skipped.reason: Unbounded: 015/016/018/020 pass with observation minors and score 5/5; forcing more revision cycles churns passing decompositions with no scored upside.

skipped.reason: Skill triggers and runs correctly on all 8 val tasks; no defect in this cluster lives in the orchestrator prompt; description edits risk trigger behavior.
